regime_context: The detector shows Memory/HBM & Storage as the dominant attention theme with AI Infrastructure as a distant challenger (margin 2.524); rotation breadth is broad (39/49 eligible) but directional/one-narrative flags are false. Cross-sectional rank is attention-only (rank-IC weak), the validated edge is trend-gate drawdown control (gate_helps true), and track record is weak (dir_accuracy 0.32), so convictions stay low.
emerging_watch: Watch for AI Infrastructure leadership forming: the watch would resolve if AI Infrastructure overtakes Memory in the detector leader score and holds above it for five consecutive sessions; it would end if Memory's durability_bar rises and the leader margin widens again.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is one of the few scorable themes with trend-gate eligibility, trend hurst, full breadth, and no crowding caution. The lean is a vol-aware trend-following conditional, not a return forecast: it only holds while GDX remains above the absolute-trend gate.
theses.dissent: Rising real yields or a sharp risk-on rotation into AI/semis could hit gold miners; the detector's own directional track record is poor (dir_accuracy 0.32).

falsifier.text: GDX closes below its detector trend-gate level for three consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Crypto & Digital Rails
theses.thesis: Crypto & Digital Rails is below the absolute-trend gate (eligible false) with low durability and mixed texture; the detector's only validated edge is drawdown avoidance below the gate, so this is an avoidance lean rather than a short or fade of a crowded leader.
theses.dissent: Crypto can snap back on unscheduled headline/surprise policy flow; an avoid lean can underperform a fast mean-reversion rally.

falsifier.text: IBIT closes back above its detector trend-gate level and holds for five consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
